paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
notes: CASPEr-electric (207Pb solid-state NMR in polarized PMN-PT ferroelectric). Main result is the axion-EDM coupling g_d; Fig 3(a) left y-axis. Paper's g_d matches the canonical AxionEDM definition exactly: H_EDM=g_d a E*.I/I, oscillating nucleon EDM d_n=g_d a (no conversion needed). Curve traced from raster of Fig 3(a) (blue bathtub boundary). x-axis calibrated from the top Compton-frequency ticks (39.0/39.65/40.3 MHz at EPS x=111.94/428.06/744.19) converted to mass via m=h*nu; y-axis log decades =83.2 EPS px, 10^0 at EPS y=1098.3. Flat-bottom best limit read ~8.9e-4 GeV^-2, consistent with the paper's stated |g_d|<9.5e-4 GeV^-2 (95% CL) over 39.1-40.2 MHz (162-166 neV). Walls of the bathtub rise to ~1 GeV^-2 at the band edges. Dark-matter search: limit scales with sqrt(rho_DM); paper assumes rho_DM=m_a^2 a_0^2/2=3.6e-42 GeV^4 (~0.4-0.47 GeV/cm^3), reported here not rescaled. The paper also reports a secondary gradient-coupling bound |g_aNN|<2.8e-1 GeV^-1 (right y-axis) which is not the main result. g_d also corresponds to oscillating neutron EDM amplitude <1.0e-21 e.cm and CP-violating theta amplitude <4.3e-6.
